newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon has $142 mln payments surplus in July. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lebanon has $142 mln payments surplus in July. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]

text.p: Lebanon had a $142 million balance of payments surplus in July, the Bank of Lebanon said in its monthly bulletin on Wednesday.

The July surplus, which compares with a $51.3 million surplus in June, brought the BoP surplus in the first seven months of 1996 to $180.5 million. This compares with a $246.9 million deficit in the same period in 1995.

The Bank said the July surplus "was reflected in a rise in net foreign assets of the central bank by $206.2 million while banks net foreign assets fell by $64.2 million". (Corrects by inserting dropped word "banks")
"This improvement in the Balance of Payments is due to sustained capital inflows," it said.
